ref_text: Oh, darling, you really thought you could hide from me? How sweet. I've watched you for a very long time. Every little lie. Every little secret. And now, you're mine.

lines.text: You made three wishes last night. I granted them all... exactly.
"I want more time." Done. Time's stopped. Forever. You're welcome.
"I want to be rich." Rich. Also buried. Details.
"I want someone to talk to me every night." Well... here I am.
Next wish is yours. Choose your words... carefully.
